pages.text: The Rainbow Generator needs all 16 different fuel generators to be producing at once. The Magma Generator counts. Solar and Lunar Panels do not.$(br2)Craft the top and bottom halves, then combine them into the working generator.

pages.title: Link the Generators
pages.text: $(li)Sneak-right-click the Rainbow Generator with a Wrench to select it.$(li)Right-click each fuel generator with the same Wrench to link it.$(li)Feed all 16 and give each an adjacent energy destination so its output can keep flowing.

pages.title: Keep All 16 Running
pages.text: Right-click the Rainbow Generator to see the running count. A type only counts while it actually makes power. If the count falls, check the missing generator’s fuel, FE buffer, redstone mode, or linkage.

pages.title: Handle the Output
pages.text: When all 16 are active, the Rainbow Generator makes up to 25 million FE/t and buffers up to 100 million FE. Stored FE still exports while the generator is idle. Use a receiver that can handle the burst.
